item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We are clear: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We demand a legally binding prohibition on its development.

2. We will not accept a billion deaths as the price of technological progress. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe on at least that scale. We call for a binding ban on its development.

3. We stand for a future with humanity in it. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We must prohibit its development—not merely ask developers to be careful.

### (b) Newsletter opening

Our position is clear: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We refuse to treat those lives as an acceptable sacrifice for technological ambition. We are working for a legally binding prohibition on developing superintelligence because voluntary promises cannot substitute for enforceable law. We have no safe method for building these systems, and we will not accept humanity being subjected to an irreversible experiment. We must act before development puts prevention beyond our reach. Together, we can demand that governments protect our future rather than let companies gamble it away.
